ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, D is a point on the extension of BC, $\angle B=50^\circ$, $\angle ACD=120^\circ$. What is the value of $\angle A$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} It is known from the properties of the exterior angles of a triangle that,
\[
\angle A = \angle ACD - \angle B = 70^\circ,
\]
thus, \(\angle A = \boxed{70^\circ}\).
